recommendation: Keep the fix. It preserves the FHIR-7888 correction away from a single practitioner while aligning the current active source with later PA decisions that allow non-person participant actors.
issue_request: FHIR-7888 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core PA issue requesting that Encounter.participant stop being defined as the main practitioner responsible for the service, because participant.individual could also be a RelatedPerson; the accepted text was the list of people responsible for providing the service.
initial_application: Commit 6a7d0cdd1a574368d73980b35cdfeb71b784de14 explicitly applied Tracker #7888 to the old Encounter spreadsheet source, changing the definition from the main-practitioner wording to the people-responsible wording. Later source refactors carried that wording into source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml and related checked-in Encounter artifacts.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published PA decisions broadened Encounter.participant.actor beyond people: FHIR-20511 added Device support and renamed individual to actor, FHIR-22696 finalized the actor target set including Patient, Group, Device, and HealthcareService, and FHIR-35841 aligned actor wording to individual/device/service. Those related issues already have combined-branch reconcile commits, so they were context rather than duplicate decisions.
reconciliation: Updated source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so Encounter.participant now says "List of participants involved in the encounter." The same wording was applied to source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml and the checked-in source/encounter/encounter.svg tooltip to avoid stale people-only wording in current Encounter source surfaces.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: changed Encounter.participant definition to participant-neutral wording.
source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized the Event performer mapping exception resource definition text.
source/encounter/encounter.svg: synchronized the checked-in Encounter diagram tooltip with the new definition.

related_jiras.note: Added Device support to Encounter.participant and renamed individual to actor; already represented on the combined branch.
